root_idea.summary: Constriction or obstruction in the throat, especially from food.
root_idea.development: The physical image of food obstructing the throat extends in Classical usage to choking by liquid, wrath, or spittle, to grief, crowding, and the agonies of death; Form IV expresses causation.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed as the normalized Quranic noun citation form غُصَّة.

senses.definition: A thing lodged in the throat and causing choking; choking food.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression ذَا غُصَّةٍ, describing food that sticks fast in the throat and is difficult to swallow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the throat or fauces to become choked or obstructed by food or liquid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I usage; the obstructing substance may be expressed with بِ, as with food or water.
In the idiom غَصَّ بِرِيقِهِ, literally describing choking by one's spittle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become choked with wrath or rage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Extended usage with بِالغَيْظِ as the accompanying expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become grieved or disquieted in mind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as an extended usage, including usage without an added object or cause.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For land or a place to become straitened or crowded, as though choked up by its occupants.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with land, a sitting-place, or another place that is made crowded by those in it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone's throat or fauces to become choked or obstructed by food or liquid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Causative/transitive Form IV; the affected person or throat may be construed as the object, with the obstructing substance understood or expressed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to become choked with wrath or rage.
To cause someone to become grieved or disquieted in mind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Extended causative usage, including the idiom غَصَّهُ بِرِيقِهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make land or a place straitened or cramped for someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Extended causative construction with the land or place made narrow or crowded.
Extended nominal usage associated with the sense of being inwardly choked or distressed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The chokings or strangulations of death; the death-rattles or agonies of death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Extended plural or collective usage in the expression غُصَصُ المَوْتِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One whose throat or fauces is choked or obstructed by food.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Active-participial description of a person experiencing the physical obstruction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place filled with people, as though choked up by them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to an abode, place of alighting, or mosque crowded with people.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Physical choking of the throat by food or liquid.
A place becoming straitened or crowded.
Making land or a place straitened.
Physical noun sense, explicitly illustrated by Quran 73:13.
Pointer-only entry referring to the following entry.
Active participle for one experiencing throat obstruction.
Active participial use for a crowded place.
Pointer-only entry referring to the preceding entry.

cautions: The extended senses involving wrath, grief, crowding, and death are Classical usages; the supplied Quranic evidence directly attests the physical choking sense only.
